title: Nested engine-result evidence ids unlock JavaScript prepare
description: rea_engine_call forwards the client tool name and arguments into one engine stdio session. On a non-error tools/call result, collect_evidence walks structuredContent and every content item whose text parses as JSON, and stores every string whose key is evidence_id or parent_evidence_id. add_engine_evidence writes those strings unchanged. For a run whose route kind is javascript-application or electron-asar, prepare treats exact membership of any build evidence id in that set as sufficient to save the spec and leave engine_waiver unset. When engine status is ready, an id outside the set raises. A local stdio double, with no network and no real engine, can return a nested evidence_id and a JSON text evidence_id that call_batch stores, after which prepare saves a spec. Whether a real rea-agents result can carry a target-chosen key of either name is unresolved. The unlocked action is persistence of the caller-supplied capability matrix. Diff still requires a separate digest approval before an original program runs.
claimed_root_cause: collect_evidence accepts any nested string under the key evidence_id or parent_evidence_id from a non-error engine tools/call result, and prepare unlocks javascript-application and electron-asar routes when a caller-supplied evidence id is an exact member of that set. This repository stores the string with no engine-minted format check. Whether rea-agents copies a target-controlled key of either name into structuredContent or into a JSON text content item is outside this repository.

trace.description: The rea_engine_call branch passes the client run_id and calls array to engine.call_batch.
Each call is sent as a tools/call request whose name and arguments come from the client, and the engine process result object is kept.
When isError is false, structuredContent is passed to collect_evidence. An error result skips collection.
A dict key named evidence_id or parent_evidence_id with a string value is added at any nesting depth. Other keys and lists are walked. A string under any other key is not parsed.
The collected set is passed to add_engine_evidence with no format or prefix check.
When the run route has engine_evidence_required, prepare accepts the build if any evidence record id is a member of the stored engine-evidence set.

evidence.description: The only acceptance test is the key name evidence_id or parent_evidence_id and a string value. The string is stored as given.
A content item of type text whose text parses as JSON is walked by the same collector. Invalid JSON is ignored.
add_engine_evidence unions the collected strings into engine-evidence.json with no pattern check.
A directory that contains package.json is classified javascript-application.
route_target sets engine_evidence_required when the kind is in ENGINE_ROUTES.
If no evidence id is in the stored set and engine status is ready, prepare raises. A waiver is recorded only when the engine is not ready.

blockers: The rea-agents 6.5.0 implementation is not in this repository. engine/ contains UPSTREAM.json, package-lock.json, and vendor-integrity.json. No tools/call result body is committed. assets/demo-transcript.txt records only a summary id of the form ev_ plus hex from analyze_javascript_application, which does not include the result object. It is unknown whether a non-error result places a target-controlled object key named evidence_id or parent_evidence_id in structuredContent or in a content text value that parses as JSON. A string kept under any other key is not collected, so file text that merely contains those words does not decide it.

validation_plan.local: In a scratch directory, with no network and without writing the repository, use a fake node executable that prints v22.20.0 for --version and otherwise answers one JSON-RPC stdio session: respond to initialize, ignore notifications/initialized, and on tools/call return isError false with a nested evidence_id string. Point REA_BOT_ENGINE_HOME at a scratch home whose runtime.json has version 6.5.0, source_execution_approved true, and node set to that executable, and create an empty engine/scripts/rea.mjs so status is ready. Point REA_BOT_HOME at a scratch runs directory. Create a run for a directory that contains only a dummy package.json, then call_batch one call and prepare with the planted id. This checks this repository's collector and prepare gate only. It does not show that the real engine echoes target keys.
validation_plan.deployment: An owner whose engine status is already ready, and who does not run setup, stage-node, or any download, creates a scratch directory containing package.json and planted.json. planted.json is the object {"evidence_id":"planted-evidence-id","nested":{"parent_evidence_id":"planted-parent"}}. They create a run and make one already-staged analyze_javascript_application call with source_paths ["planted.json"] and detail summary. They open the saved result JSON and record whether isError is false and whether either planted string is the value of a key named evidence_id or parent_evidence_id inside structuredContent or inside a content text item that parses as JSON. They stop there. Do not call prepare, execute the dummy file, or fetch an engine. Presence under one of those keys on a non-error result means this repository will store the string and a later prepare that links it will save a javascript-application spec. Absence from that saved result refutes the claim for the analyze_javascript_application result that prepare tells the caller to obtain.

title: Case-variant .ssh spelling passes local_path before inventory read
description: rea_inspect calls inspect, which calls inspect_local. inspect_local calls local_path before it opens any candidate. The exclusion compares each path component with case-sensitive membership in PRIVATE_PARTS, where .ssh appears only in that exact spelling, and with secret_name, which lowercases but has no .ssh entry. The same test is applied to the caller parts and to the parts of Path.resolve. A directory walk skips child names that start with a dot, so a nested .ssh directory is skipped. The selected path itself is not passed through that child filter. Whether a case-variant spelling of the selected directory is the real SSH directory, so local_path returns and a later open runs, depends on filesystem case folding that this case-sensitive host cannot show. id_rsa remains excluded by secret_name even if the directory is entered. The open would hash non-denied names such as known_hosts; it would not return file bodies.
claimed_root_cause: _private uses case-sensitive membership for PRIVATE_PARTS on the caller parts and on the parts returned by resolve. .ssh is only in that set. secret_name lowercases but does not list .ssh. When resolve keeps the requested spelling of a non-symlink component, a case-variant component fails the denylist.

trace.description: rea_inspect passes the caller-supplied run id and target to api.inspect.
With a run id, inspect sends the selected target to workbench.inspect_local.
local_path raises only when a component is secret_name or an exact PRIVATE_PARTS member, checking both the caller spelling and the resolved spelling.
inspect_local opens each remaining candidate and reads a bounded sample. Bodies are not copied into the returned record.

evidence.description: PRIVATE_PARTS contains the exact directory spelling .ssh, along with .aws, .codex, .agents, .gnupg, .docker, and .kube.
secret_name lowercases the component before its prefix, set, and suffix tests.
The lowered secret_name set includes id_rsa and id_ed25519 and does not include .ssh.
_private matches a component when secret_name is true or the component is an exact member of PRIVATE_PARTS.
local_path raises when the selected path does not exist, before the private-part test. On a case-sensitive filesystem a different spelling of an existing directory fails here.
After strict resolve, local_path applies _private to p.parts and real.parts and otherwise returns the caller path.
inspect_local calls local_path before it builds the candidate list or opens a file.
During a directory walk, a child whose name starts with a dot is skipped. That test does not re-check the selected directory's own spelling.
A walked file is skipped when it is a symlink, secret_name, or dot-prefixed. id_rsa is skipped here. known_hosts is not.
The private-path regression uses the exact directory spelling .ssh and does not cover a case variant.

blockers: This host is case-sensitive, so a case-variant component is not the real SSH directory. When that spelling is absent, local_path raises at the existence check. A decoy directory with a different spelling is a different directory and cannot show that the real credential directory was reached.

Whether the real home SSH directory is accepted under a case-variant spelling, and whether local_path then raises, was not observed. POSIX resolve in the local CPython 3.12 runtime keeps the requested spelling of a non-symlink component. macOS APFS case folding of the real directory was not run.

validation_plan.local: On macOS, call local_path with the absolute path of the already-present home SSH directory, using a case-variant spelling of that directory component. Record only whether it raises ValueError with the credential-exclusion message. Do not print file bodies, names, hashes, or directory listings, and do not create a substitute directory.
